name: Kelley Sprint Case Competition
org: Indiana University Kelley School of Business
what_you_do: A one-day business case competition on the IU Bloomington campus. Work alone or on a team of four, hear Kelley faculty lectures and meet current Kelley students.
who_can_apply: Any high school student. Only 50 team spots are available.
pay_detail: No cost to apply or attend
deadline_text: 2026 edition: apply by August 28; competition Saturday October 3 (2026). Next dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application, first come first served.
notes: The page shows the August 28 and October 3 dates without a year; the date has already passed this fall. Travel costs are not discussed on the page. Expect it to repeat in fall 2027 but confirm.
